name: trello-mcp
description: Local Trello tools with compact responses, workspace allowlists and read-only opt-in.
long_description:
Independent Trello integration, not affiliated with Atlassian. macOS and Windows amd64 are supported; Windows on Arm is not claimed.

1. Create your personal API key at https://trello.com/power-ups/admin.
2. In your browser, replace YOUR_KEY with that key in https://trello.com/1/authorize?key=YOUR_KEY&scope=read,write&expiration=30days&name=trello-mcp&response_type=token, open it, approve access and copy the token. For a read-only token, replace scope=read,write with scope=read.
3. Paste the key and token into the masked fields, save and restart the extension.
4. Ask Claude to run workspace_find {} to verify Trello access.

Never share your key, token or personalized authorization URL in chat, logs or agent-captured commands. No shared application key is provided.

Tokens expire after 30 days: repeat step 2 for a new token, replace the token in settings and restart. Uninstalling does not revoke tokens; revoke them in your Trello account's authorized applications.

Help: https://avhn.github.io/trello-mcp/setup/

tools.name: server_health
tools.description: Local config health, not Trello auth; verify with workspace_find. Policy shows access restrictions.

api_key.title: Trello API key
api_key.description: Your personal API key from Trello Power-Up administration (step 1).

token.title: Trello token
token.description: Your personal token from the browser authorization in step 2.

allowed_workspaces.title: Allowed workspaces (optional)
allowed_workspaces.description: Comma-separated workspace IDs or URL short names, not display names; empty allows all accessible workspaces within token permissions.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Hide write and transfer tools in this server only, without changing token permissions.

download_dir.title: Attachment download directory (optional)
download_dir.description: Absolute download directory (empty uses temporary storage); Windows refuses downloads and this setting cannot enable them.

upload_dir.title: Attachment upload directory (optional)
upload_dir.description: Absolute path-upload directory (empty disables path uploads); Windows refuses path uploads and this setting cannot enable them.
